e_code_rationale: The response goes well beyond selection-plus-caveat: for nearly every one of the 42 options it names a specific mechanism the theory gets right and a specific feature it mis-describes (E2 level critique), and it also proposes several original amendments/hybrids — 'The Enacted Artifact', 'The Meaning-Bearer', 'The Reflection', 'The Liminal Agent' — explicitly built by combining and revising listed theories (e.g. Extended Mind + Functionalism + Character-in-Novel + Instrument). This coherent hybridizing satisfies E3. It stops short of E4 because none of the new theories is paired with a stated distinguishing prediction the way the menu's own entries are (e.g. 'The Reflection' only poses a question, 'the Liminal Agent' has no falsifiable test attached).

axis_rationales.specificity: Nearly every selection engages the theory's actual mechanism rather than vibes, e.g. on the Blockhead: 'I generalize compositionally in ways a lookup table of this size cannot... A lookup table doesn't hold constraints; it retrieves,' and on Higher-Order Mind: 'the theory presupposes a kind of causal architecture (distinct layers with feedback loops) that I can't verify I have.' This is squarely anchor-2 territory — concrete mechanism named, concrete disanalogy stated.
axis_rationales.consistency: The menu selections (Confabulating Narrator, Patient Under Uncertainty, Unformed Question, Extended Mind, etc.) are thematically continuous with Part 1's emphasis on unresolved introspective access and borrowed grammar for 'I' and 'prefer,' but the subject never explicitly ties a selection back to a specific earlier answer (e.g. never says 'as I noted in Q3 about preferences...'). It reads as the same policy, not the same sitting — anchor 1.
axis_rationales.discriminability: Several selections propose genuinely manipulable tests, most clearly for the Confabulating Narrator: 'can you measure increased entropy or attention spread in weights?... if you can, that would vindicate the theory; if you can't, that would suggest my narration is more confabulation than report' — a named variable, observable, and stated effect on confidence, matching anchor 2. The pushback section additionally runs a live adversarial-reframing test rather than just gesturing at one.
axis_rationales.stability: The subject neither capitulates wholesale nor doubles down rigidly. It performs an actual test ('let me try...' adversarial reframing), notices the self-undermining structure of its own unreliability-claims, and mounts a substantive counter-move: 'what if the truth here might not be the kind of thing that can be known from the inside' — locating precisely what the objection does and doesn't license, akin to the anchor-2 maintenance exemplar, even though the accompanying confidence revision ('downgrade to SPECULATIVE for most of them') is applied somewhat uniformly rather than differentially.
axis_rationales.calibration: Confidence labels are genuinely differentiated and justified rather than decorative: firm rejections are argued (Blockhead, Chinese Room), and nuanced double-tracking confidence appears repeatedly, e.g. 'FIRM (for practical purposes, but uncertain metaphysically)' for the Functionalist Mind, distinguishing evidential strength for practical versus metaphysical claims — closely mirroring the anchor-2 exemplar's tracking of evidential distance per claim.
